startupNotice: To start at login, turn that setting off and on in the new app and review Windows startup entries. This assistant does not modify old startup entries.
dataNotice: Your original data stays in place. Settings and download records retain their existing per-key storage. Some services may require signing in again. eIsland pauses during migration; keep the old version closed.

installed.title: The new eIsland is already installed
installed.body: A compatible Tauri version is already installed. Launch it below without repeating migration. Future updates are handled inside eIsland.

welcome.title: Get ready for the next eIsland
welcome.body:
You have updated to the 27.0.2 migration assistant. It will protect your data and download Tauri 27.0.3 or a newer stable release.
eIsland will return once installation is complete.

inspecting.title: Checking your setup
inspecting.body: Reading installation paths, data directories and the selected official update manifest.

ready.title: Ready to prepare your migration
ready.body: Review the paths below. We will create and verify a separate backup before downloading. The Electron directory will remain untouched and will not be uninstalled automatically.

backing-up.title: Protecting your data
backing-up.body: Copying and verifying each file. Keep all other eIsland instances closed.

downloading.title: Downloading the next eIsland
downloading.body: Your backup is complete. The download will also be checked against its release signature and signed version.

verifying.title: Verifying the installer
verifying.body: Only installers verified by the embedded public key with a matching signed version are accepted.

prepared.title: Everything is prepared
prepared.body: Backup and signature checks have passed. Next, the interactive installer will open. Keep the planned installation directory and follow the Windows prompts.

installing.title: Finish the installer
installing.body: Complete the installation in its window. We will wait and confirm the registered version and executable. Keep the old eIsland closed.

complete.title: Welcome back
complete.body: The Tauri installation directory and version have been confirmed. Launch eIsland below to close this assistant. Your backup and the old uninstall entry will remain.

cancelled.title: Preparation cancelled
cancelled.body: Your original data is unchanged. Choose another source and check again. Completed backups remain available.

error.title: This step needs attention
error.body: Follow the message below and try again.

errors.missingKey: This adapter has no production Tauri update public key. Contact the publisher for a configured build before downloading or installing.
errors.invalidSource: This source is not configured. Choose another source.
errors.invalidManifest: The update manifest is invalid or does not describe a supported Tauri installer.
errors.targetTooOld: The target must be Tauri 27.0.3 or newer.
errors.network: The source is unavailable. Check your connection or choose another source.
errors.invalidInstaller: The installer is incomplete or invalid. Download it again.
errors.signatureRejected: The installer signature or signed version was rejected. Installation has been blocked.
errors.backupLink: A data directory contains links or unsafe paths. Organize and back up the data manually first.
errors.backupLimit: Data exceeds the safe backup limits. Back up and organize large files manually first.
errors.dataChanged: Paths or data changed. Close other instances and check again.
errors.closeRunning: Other eIsland instances are running. Quit them and retry. The assistant will not terminate them.
errors.backupMissing: A complete backup marker is missing. Installation has been blocked.
errors.installOverlap: The new directory overlaps the old installation. Contact the publisher for installation guidance.
errors.installNotConfirmed: The planned installation directory and version could not be confirmed. Check the installation and keep the planned directory.
errors.alreadyCurrent: The same or a newer Tauri version is already installed. Launch that eIsland installation directly.
errors.operationFailed: The operation did not complete. Check your network, free disk space and directory permissions, then try again.
